Perfect! All 41 tests pass. I've added two new functions and two error codes:

**New error codes in src/errors.js:**
- `NOT_DRAFT` — only draft invoices can be edited
- `LINE_NOT_FOUND` — SKU not found on the invoice

**New functions in src/invoices.js:**

**addLine(invoice, { sku, qty })** — adds a line or increments an existing one
- If SKU already on invoice, adds qty to that line
- If SKU is new, appends a new line with details from the catalogue
- Validates qty (QTY_INVALID), SKU existence (UNKNOWN_SKU), and draft status (NOT_DRAFT)

**removeLine(invoice, sku)** — removes a line by SKU
- Returns LINE_NOT_FOUND if SKU not on invoice
- Returns NO_LINES if removing the last line
- Returns NOT_DRAFT if invoice is not draft

**Test coverage:**
- addLine: new line, increment existing, all validation errors, draft-only enforcement, immutability
- removeLine: removal, all error cases, immutability
